explanation: Cardinal Richelieu set up the Académie française in 1635 to guard the French language. Spain's academy followed in 1713, with the motto 'Limpia, fija y da esplendor': it cleans, fixes and gives splendour.

claims.text: The Académie française was founded in 1635 under Cardinal Richelieu.
The Royal Spanish Academy (Real Academia Española) was founded in 1713.
The Royal Spanish Academy's motto is 'Limpia, fija y da esplendor' ('it cleans, fixes and gives splendour').
